observation.command:
cd /workspace/01-frontend && docker run --rm -v /workspace/01-frontend:/w -w /w node:20-bookworm sh -c '
HUSKY=0 npm ci --workspace shell --include-workspace-root=false >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "standalone @types/react: $(node -p "require(\"@types/react/package.json\").version" 2>&1)"
rm -rf node_modules
HUSKY=0 npm ci >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "full @types/react: $(node -p "require(\"@types/react/package.json\").version" 2>&1)"
echo "full RHF: $(node -p "require(\"react-hook-form/package.json\").version" 2>&1)"'
